answer: Sybil resistance follows from exponential temporal decay: reputation loses half its weight each half-life, so influence requires sustained honest service. EigenTrust-style centrality comes from reciprocal endorsements that propagate through trusted peers; newly spawned identities such as Prism, Saffron, or Plume begin with negligible support and near-zero centrality. Without established, corroborating paths, they cannot accumulate enough trust to pass consensus thresholds.
